"Still on wanting to be in charge."

"This one — Tamarind. Leaf, stem, smell. You won't forget it now."
"This one — Water Chestnut. Leaf, stem, smell. You won't forget it now."

"This one — Bittersweet Nightshade. Leaf, stem, smell. You won't forget it now."

"Oh — okay. Later, then."
